headline: Tanaka Seimitsu Kogyo Co., Ltd. Files Report on Ransomware Incident
body: Tanaka Seimitsu Kogyo Co., Ltd. has filed a regulatory report detailing a recent ransomware attack that forced a partial shutdown of its operations. The automotive components supplier disclosed that the breach involved the theft of internal data, including financial records, which were later leaked by the attackers. Tanaka Seimitsu Kogyo Co., Ltd. is actively engaged with incident responders to restore its systems and improve its cybersecurity measures.
